shared_mechanics: Private CreateTokensForChosenCreatureType instruction advances pc before presenting the public mandatory type choice.
CreatureType is the existing validated pinned taxonomy index, serialized by name. Every valid type is offered, regardless of current creatures or hidden information.

Private Resolution.chosen_creature_type retains the public choice through replacement/entry suspension; no separate State allocation or mutable card definition. One existing synthetic Resolution initializer gains None.

Choosing a type samples current controlled battlefield creature kinds/subtypes, including tokens, Changeling and type/control changes. The amount is passed once to existing create_tokens and replacement-aware token batching. Resume continues after the choice instruction.

Existing attached-combat-player-damage trigger, Equipment stats/keyword layer fragments and ordinary sorcery-speed equip are composed unchanged. Policy ranks the type choice from only the acting player public battlefield observation.

assertion_map.obligation: Pay printed generic three to cast and three to equip. Reject insufficient mana, opposing-turn equip and opposing creature target. Equipped Bear becomes 4/4 with trample and deals two overflow damage through a Bear blocker. One Treasure is an untapped colorless noncreature artifact with the actual tap/sacrifice-for-white-mana activation.

Offered type actions exactly equal the complete pinned taxonomy. One bounded single-choice branch for every valid type proves current Changeling contributes to each, Bear/Wolf creatures contribute to their types, creature tokens count, and opposing/graveyard/noncreature Kindred cards do not count. An absent type creates zero tokens. Invalid/noncreature-type names fail validation/deserialization.

Count is sampled at resolution choice, after control changes and an actual subtype-layer override. Controlled foreign-owned Bear counts, former controlled Bear does not, creature now Elf does not count as Bear. Orcrist can leave after triggering without preventing its ability.

Equipment control changes while it remains attached to the opposing controlled creature. Equipment controller chooses publicly and counts its own creatures, receiving its own Treasures independently of the creature controller.

Resolved layer-six ability removal suppresses Equipment bonuses and its combat trigger. Its historical source leaving does not end that source-independent effect. A new Orcrist incarnation plus paid re-equip restores printed stats, trample and combat trigger.
Actual core damage batches distinguish noncombat player damage and combat creature-only damage from the positive real combat/player event.

Real double-strike combat gives two independently resolving type choices. Dwarf creates one Treasure from the first event; absent Aetherborn creates zero from the second. Player takes three damage in each step.

Two Doubling Seasons suspend token replacement ordering and yield exactly four Treasures. Chosen Bear type stays public to both seats. Raw/index equivalence, parent disposal, independent children and snapshot restore at type choice and replacement choice preserve the once-created batch.

One bounded reused token slot at maximum generation fails during actual ChooseCreatureType execution, after recording the selected type. Capacity error restores snapshot, revision, both observations and unselected public view; no allocation/OOM probe.
